title: Ember Amulet
description: The <keyword>Ember Ring</keyword>, <keyword>Amulet</keyword> and <keyword>Belt</keyword> <positive>reduce the Ember cost</positive> of clockwork tools and Ember weapons.
Each piece gives a different reduction, and they <property>stack</property> - wear all three.
